text:
Situation: Acetaminophen 10 mg/mL 100 mL bags are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 497 bags (26.9 days), Corvale General holds 300 bags (15.7 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 37 bags (8.8 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include acetaminophen as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate system-wide but unevenly distributed. Corvale Lakeside is below a two-week buffer. Internal transfers can resolve the imbalance without external purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 22 bags from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. If Option 1 cannot be executed, transfer 22 bags from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. If transfers are not feasible, purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. or Caplin Steriles Limited while internal transfer options exist and preferred suppliers are available.
